title: Sunday · two-thirds
logline: A Sunday from the small weeks. The bay at dusk, wide and correct. Wood in it, small, and smaller than that.

panels.composition: Tier 1: Alsea Bay at low tide, dusk, watercolor, wide and beautiful — the mudflats, the channel, the far spruce, the sky bruised. On the flats, two figures, small: a man and a dog. The man is drawn smaller than the dog's scale would allow.

image.prompt: a wide watercolor of a Pacific Northwest bay at low tide at dusk, mudflats and a channel catching a bruised sky, distant spruce, and on the flats a man and a dog where the man is drawn slightly too small for his distance, no words
image.notes: The two-thirds device applied to a landscape: Wood smaller than perspective allows.

panels.name: The flats

panels.composition: Tier 2: closer. The dog, right-sized. Wood beside him, still wrong-sized, looking at the water.

image.prompt: a man drawn two-thirds his correct size standing beside a correctly sized dog on wet sand at dusk, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Wrong-sized

panels.composition: Tier 3: from behind, the two of them walking back. The sky. Normal proportions restored in this tier only — the strip letting itself, for one tier, be the right size.

image.prompt: a man and a dog seen from behind walking back across mudflats under a dusk sky, the man now at his correct size, watercolor, no words
image.notes: Only the from-behind view gets the right size. The reader can decide why.

panels.name: From behind

art.palette: limited; Sundays in watercolor, good now
art.paper: bristol; the browser; from 2008 coastal newsprint a week behind

notes: The Sunday from the small weeks the book keeps. Wrong-sized from the front, right-sized from behind.
